title: How Pidgeot Hunts Magikarp From 3,300 Feet Up
premise: Pidgeot can spot splashing Magikarp from 3,300 feet up, then race toward prey at Mach 2.
audiencePromise: See how Pidgeot turns one tiny splash far below into a water-skimming hunt.
openLoop: What can Pidgeot do after spotting a Magikarp splash from that high?
payoff: Its vision finds the target, Mach 2 speed closes distance, and feared talons threaten at the waterline.
engagementQuestion: Sky hunter or water hunter: which is scarier?

voice.instructions: Urgent, cinematic, and precise. Pause after each number. Build from distant wonder to sudden danger, then end with a playful challenge.

scenes.headline: THE SPLASH GIVES IT AWAY
scenes.narration: It notices the splash while already flying far overhead.
scenes.caption: TARGET FOUND

scenes.headline: MACH 2 TOWARD PREY

scenes.headline: IT SKIMS THE WATER
